title: Joint Detection of Constructive Speech, Hate Speech and Agreement in Online Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2611.32889v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online hate speech is an ever-growing issue with negative impacts on both groups and individuals, potentially causing users to withdraw from online conversations and debate. With some prominent social media platforms reducing their moderation efforts, constructive speech has emerged as an alternative strategy for countering hate. Automated detection of constructive and hateful speech can aid monitoring and improve understanding of their prevalence and online dynamics. In this work, we collect and annotate a large dataset of English and Danish social media comments for hateful tone, constructive tone, and agreement with parent comments. We fine-tune several multilingual LLMs to classify along these three dimensions and compare context-enriched and non-context-enriched model architectures. translated_title: 在线对话中建设性言论、仇恨言论与赞同态度的联合检测
translated_abstract: 在线仇恨言论是一个日益严重的问题，对群体和个人都产生负面影响，可能导致用户退出在线对话和辩论。随着一些知名社交媒体平台减少其审核力度，建设性言论已成为对抗仇恨的替代策略。自动检测建设性言论和仇恨言论有助于监测工作，并增进对其流行程度和在线动态的理解。在这项工作中，我们收集并标注了一个大型数据集，包含英语和丹麦语社交媒体评论，标注维度包括仇恨语气、建设性语气以及对父评论的赞同程度。我们微调了多个多语言大语言模型在这三个维度上进行分类，并比较了上下文增强与非上下文增强的模型架构。E5-large 大语言模型在上下文增强（平均 F1 为 82%）和非上下文增强（平均 F1 为 81.6%）分类任务中均表现最佳，证明了……
tldr: 本文构建了一个标注了仇恨语气、建设性语气和赞同态度的英丹麦语社交媒体评论大规模数据集，并通过微调多语言大语言模型实现三项任务的联合检测，其中 E5-large 在上下文增强架构下表现最佳。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a large annotated English-Danish social media dataset for joint detection of hate tone, constructive tone, and agreement, showing that the fine-tuned E5-large LLM with context-enriched architecture achieves the best performance across all three classification tasks.
